title: ask command optimization smoke tests
desc: Smoke test script for ask optimization: dispatch latency, CDP port isolation, a11y eval block, cdp field in grap. Run: powershell -File scripts/test-ask-optimization.ps1 -Full
steps: BASIC mode: skill-search + ask-help routing only
FULL mode adds: CDP Port Isolation, Dispatch Latency (claude/gpt/gemini/triad), CDP Basic Tests (cdp open/find/read/eval-block), Agent routing
CDP Basic Tests: (1) cdp open grap contains cdp:{port} (2) a11y find cdp:{port} filters foreign Chromes (3) a11y read --eval-js works as eval replacement (4) a11y eval is BLOCKED
Thresholds: dispatch GOOD <300ms WARN >800ms BUG. Agent routing GOOD <800ms
On fail: check [CDP:PORT] log via ask log file, check wkappbot-core.new.exe was hotswapped
